title: The Touché23-ValueEval Dataset for Identifying Human Values behind Arguments

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing and comparing the distribution of human value categories across arguments collected from diverse geographic and cultural sources (e.g., Chinese Q&A platforms, Indian discussion boards, European democracy platforms, and US newspapers) to mitigate the Western-centric bias of previous datasets and evaluate cross-cultural representation.

Evaluating the distribution of human values in arguments extracted specifically from Islamic religious texts (Nahj al-Balagha) to ensure the representation of diverse moral and ethical reasoning, comparing these value distributions against secular sources.
